Occupant load: Group A-2, sprinklered (100 and over)
The shell is assumed: an existing concrete or masonry ground floor, sprinklered or able to be. A site visit decides it.
Two exits for an occupant load over 49 (CBC 1006.2): the street door through the vestibule and the rear door to the yard and side passage, more than a
third of the diagonal apart (sprinklered). Both swing outward with panic hardware (CBC 1010.2.9).
The vestibule is a sound lock: two doors in series 8 ft apart, felt-lined, so the line stays inside when guests come and go (Police Code Art. 29).
The listening room is a room within the room: double-stud walls on isolated clips, its own ceiling at 12 ft, a lobby with two doors. Its stacks face
the front, away from the party walls.
Accessible: one level throughout, 36 in routes, 44 in on the main aisle; the counter drops to 34 in for its first 5 ft 3 in (CBC 11B-902.3); 5% of
table seats at 30 in (11B-226); three single-user all-gender WCs, each with a 60 in turning circle.
Behind the bar: a hand sink at each end, a three-compartment sink and a dump sink in the underbar; ice, a glasswasher, reach-ins and a keg box under
Everything on the floor is on sale: each piece carries a card. The shop wall holds stock and the pieces not in use.
